strategy.name: Volume-Confirmed Breakout
strategy.description: Trades expansion out of consolidation, and only when volume confirms. The volume requirement is the discriminating condition: price poking above a twenty-bar high on thin volume is noise, and a breakout rule without volume confirmation is mostly a wick detector. The strategy also requires that the band width was compressed recently, so it is trading expansion rather than chasing a move that is already extended.

rules.description: Close beyond the prior twenty-bar high with volume confirmation
Volume is at least twice its twenty period average
Volume is more than two standard deviations above its recent mean
Bollinger band width is expanding out of compression
Price is more than twenty basis points above the session VWAP
RSI is extremely stretched, raising the risk of an immediate failure
The bar opened with a large gap, so the breakout may already be exhausted
Volatility is high while volume participation is only average
